items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: He used to stop here all the time. He stopped here about 17 years. He used to play back every labor day.

ctx.x: Yeah, his sister's playing piano. He's pretty good. He used to stop here all the time. He stopped here about 17 years. He used to play back every labor day. He played back here. And from here, they go to town and play. Go in.
Well, how old was Thomas when he started playing music?
